title: Drum Roll
blurb: Professional-grade anticipation, entirely indifferent to the size of the news. Every announcement becomes an event once it arrives on a snare roll: a raffle result, a baby's name, a decision about where four people are going to eat. The longer you let the roll run, the higher the stakes climb, regardless of whether any stakes exist at all. The mechanism has never once failed. Cut it with a cymbal crash for dignity, or with a fart for accuracy. Both are correct.
origin: The classic snare drum roll of announcements and reveals.
